options.text: Claude Code's agentic abilities applied to knowledge work: Claude plans and executes multi-step tasks for you
A shared chat room for your coworkers

questions.explanation: Cowork brings Claude Code's agentic capabilities to knowledge work beyond coding, without needing a terminal. It's available on paid plans.

questions.prompt: Match each Cowork permission mode to its behavior.

pairs.right: Claude asks before actions; you allow or deny
Claude reviews each action and blocks unsafe ones

questions.explanation: Manual gives full control, Auto adds safety checks (using more of your limit), and Skip removes checks, so use it only when you completely trust everything involved.

questions.prompt: You create a scheduled task in Cowork with the ____ command.
questions.explanation: Scheduled tasks run on demand or on a cadence, in the cloud with no device online; create one with /schedule.

questions.prompt: Which require the Claude desktop app to be open and connected? Select all that apply.

options.text: A scheduled task that only searches the web and writes a doc in the cloud

questions.explanation: Tasks run in an isolated cloud environment, but local file access, browser use, and computer use need the desktop app running. Cloud-only scheduled tasks don't.

questions.prompt: Order the parts of a good Cowork brief.

items.text: Constraints: format, limits, what not to touch
Inputs: which files, folders, or connectors to use

questions.explanation: Treat a task like a brief to a colleague: the outcome, the inputs, the constraints, and the checkpoints where Claude should pause.

questions.prompt: Before permanently deleting any files, what does Claude require in Cowork?

options.text: Nothing; it deletes freely in every mode

questions.explanation: The Help Center states that Claude requires your explicit permission before permanently deleting any files.
